description: Search the free CC0 library of 3D models, PBR textures and HDRIs by meaning and filters. Every model is a GLB measured in metres, +Y up, origin at the base. Check size_m before placing an asset; use min_size_m >= 2 for floors and walls. previews (max 6) attaches thumbnails, which is cheaper than downloading the wrong asset. Each result has match (strong, good or weak); when none is better than weak the answer says so, and generate_model is the way to get the object. Read-only, free with a free account.

category.description: A category slug; see the categories in the results.

format.description: A file format we serve it in.

maps.description: Must have all of these maps.

max_size_m.description: The largest side at most this many metres.

min_size_m.description: The largest side at least this many metres. Use 2 or more for floors and walls.

pack.description: A pack id from a result ("kn:mini-skate"): only assets from that kit, to keep a game in one style.

previews.description: Attach this many thumbnails as images, so you can look before downloading.

q.description: What you need, in words: "wooden barrel", "mossy rock", "sci-fi crate".

similar_to.description: An asset id: the nearest to it by meaning.

name: search_assets
title: Search free CC0 3D assets
